<translate>
<!--T:8-->
'''The Cell Games''' is a four-star '''bracket''' tournament hosted by [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] at the Cell Arena on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. You fight through a bracket of Z Fighters from the Cell Saga, then [[Special:MyLanguage/Gohan|Teen Gohan]] in the semi-final and '''Super Perfect Cell''' in the final. It is the only '''lethal''' tournament: a lost bout is a real death.
</translate>

{{Note|type=danger|title=<translate><!--T:9--> Lethal ring</translate>|<translate><!--T:10--> In the Cell Games, losing a bout kills you. Every other tournament ends its bouts at knockout.</translate>}}

<translate>
== Getting there == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Arena|Cell Arena]] generates in the plains of the Overworld. A [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]] of tier 3 sells a map to it for 1 Tier-1 Radar Chip. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]].

<!--T:13-->
Cell talks to every player: his Evil alignment requirement (40 or less) only locks his '''Skills''' and '''Train''' as a master, not the tournament (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|Alignment]]). Talk to him, press '''Tournament''' and then '''Enter''' while you are within 12 blocks of him. The arena can't be built in or broken by survival players (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments#Arena protection|arena protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Format == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
This tournament is a '''bracket''' of 8 seats filled with random contenders. Winners climb the ladder, and fights between two NPCs are decided automatically. After the qualifier rounds, the survivor faces the semi-finalist, then the champion. Only those two are known before you enter; the rest of the draw is revealed once everybody accepts the rules.

<!--T:16-->
With a party, each member has their own seat; if the draw puts two members against each other, they fight a PvP bout. Each bout lasts up to '''7 minutes'''; a bout that runs out of time is void and fought again. The general rules for entering and bouts are on [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Fighters == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
The contenders are drawn from the Z Fighters of the Cell Saga and Mr. Satan: [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta|Vegeta]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Trunks|Future Trunks]] (in their base and Super Saiyan forms), [[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo|Piccolo]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Krillin|Krillin]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Tien Shinhan|Tien Shinhan]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha|Yamcha]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Android 16|Android 16]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Satan|Mr. Satan]]. By default they have between 66,500 and 210,000 health, 2,700 to 8,700 melee damage and 2,420 to 7,820 ki damage, fight on the Novice to Elite AI tiers, and get 8% stronger for every round already played.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:32-->
Each contender seat draws a character who isn't in the tournament yet, and the semi-finalist and the champion are drawn first. The forms of a character count as one, so a bracket never has two Gokus, two Vegetas or two Future Trunks. Teen Gohan is in the same pool, but the semi-finalist (Teen Gohan as a Super Saiyan) takes his place first, so he is never drawn as a contender.
</translate>

<translate>
== Rewards == <!--T:29-->

<!--T:30-->
Beating Super Perfect Cell wins '''1,000,000 TP''' and '''+10 alignment''', with fireworks and the victory music. Losing a bout, withdrawing or being disqualified puts you on a '''60-minute''' cooldown before you can enter again; winning starts the same cooldown.
</translate>
